question: What qualifies one as a guru?
premises: Even one lacking all marks, if knowledge-possessing, is regarded as guru.
Knowledge-primacy is indeed said thus in Sri Kacabhargava.
inference: Guru status depends on knowledge rather than on formal marks.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'all marks' is not specified.
The precise identity or scope of 'Sri Kacabhargava' is unclear.
plain_english: Even one who lacks all marks, if he possesses knowledge, is regarded as a guru; thus knowledge-primacy is indeed stated in Sri Kacabhargava.
